svg.title: Four Checks Before a Binding Housing Commitment
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-property-and-placement-preflight; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before a Binding Housing Commitment; subtitle: Every check must pass; a failed branch returns to remediation.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Sequential decision framework, not a numerical risk score. Cited state provisions apply only in their jurisdictions. Assess the actual property, occupancy classification, contracting structure, and local rules.; caption: Written permission, tax treatment, dwelling readiness, and funded risk allocation must agree before committing rent.; stages: label: Landlord authority; value: Pass with explicit permission; otherwise stop lease commitment; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Obtain an executed corporate-housing sublease addendum for every property. Check lease, building, and local restrictions; New York Real Property Law section 226-b has scope and procedure limits and is not blanket permission for corporate subletting.; label: Occupancy and tax treatment; value: Pass with documented classification; otherwise reprice or decline; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Review lodging classification and state plus local occupancy taxes. Texas Tax Code section 156.101 addresses the state permanent-resident exemption for at least thirty consecutive days with uninterrupted payment; do not export that rule nationwide.; label: Habitability and fair housing; value: Pass with readiness evidence; otherwise repair before occupancy; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Inspect required heating, plumbing, electrical safety, and dwelling conditions; California Civil Code section 1941.1 supplies California requirements. Apply 42 U.S.C. 3604 and 24 CFR 100.202 where applicable to screening and disability-related housing practices.; label: Insurance and closeout exposure; value: Pass with funded exposure; otherwise renegotiate before signing; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Have the broker confirm furnished corporate-sublet coverage, exclusions, and required liability limits. Compare early claim closeout with landlord lease-break costs, verify commercial insurance requirements, and assign utility overruns and uninsured losses explicitly.

text.title: Four Checks Before a Binding Housing Commitment
text.tspan: Four Checks Before a Binding Housing Commitment

circle.title: label: Landlord authority; value: Pass with explicit permission; otherwise stop lease commitment; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Obtain an executed corporate-housing sublease addendum for every property. Check lease, building, and local restrictions; New York Real Property Law section 226-b has scope and procedure limits and is not blanket permission for corporate subletting.

text.title: Obtain an executed corporate-housing sublease addendum for every property. Check lease, building, and local restrictions; New York Real Property Law section 226-b has scope and procedure limits and is not blanket permission for corporate subletting.

circle.title: label: Occupancy and tax treatment; value: Pass with documented classification; otherwise reprice or decline; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Review lodging classification and state plus local occupancy taxes. Texas Tax Code section 156.101 addresses the state permanent-resident exemption for at least thirty consecutive days with uninterrupted payment; do not export that rule nationwide.

text.title: Review lodging classification and state plus local occupancy taxes. Texas Tax Code section 156.101 addresses the state permanent-resident exemption for at least thirty consecutive days with uninterrupted payment; do not export that rule nationwide.

circle.title: label: Habitability and fair housing; value: Pass with readiness evidence; otherwise repair before occupancy; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Inspect required heating, plumbing, electrical safety, and dwelling conditions; California Civil Code section 1941.1 supplies California requirements. Apply 42 U.S.C. 3604 and 24 CFR 100.202 where applicable to screening and disability-related housing practices.

text.title: Inspect required heating, plumbing, electrical safety, and dwelling conditions; California Civil Code section 1941.1 supplies California requirements. Apply 42 U.S.C. 3604 and 24 CFR 100.202 where applicable to screening and disability-related housing practices.

circle.title: label: Insurance and closeout exposure; value: Pass with funded exposure; otherwise renegotiate before signing; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Have the broker confirm furnished corporate-sublet coverage, exclusions, and required liability limits. Compare early claim closeout with landlord lease-break costs, verify commercial insurance requirements, and assign utility overruns and uninsured losses explicitly.

text.title: Have the broker confirm furnished corporate-sublet coverage, exclusions, and required liability limits. Compare early claim closeout with landlord lease-break costs, verify commercial insurance requirements, and assign utility overruns and uninsured losses explicitly.

Assumptions: Sequential decision framework, not a numerical risk score. Cited state provisions apply only in their jurisdictions. Assess the actual property, occupancy classification, contracting structure, and local rules.
